notes: Property tax choice is uncertain for a metro this varied: SmartAsset gives Kings 0.73%, Queens 0.88%, NY state 1.45%, New York County (Manhattan) not available, no year stated. ATTOM 2025 annual tax report gives New York state effective rate 1.23% for 2025 (https://www.attomdata.com/news/market-trends/home-sales-prices/2025-annual-tax-report). Suburban counties (Nassau, Westchester, NJ) are much higher but were not found. Alternative insurance: NerdWallet (May 6, 2026) NY $1,710/yr at $400,000 dwelling. Home-price index: FHFA purchase-only (replaced Case-Shiller/FHFA all-transactions on 2026-10-22).
